capabilities: Convert Markdown to WeChat-compatible HTML with 22 themes and live preview
Push drafts directly to the WeChat Official Account API using AppID/AppSecret
Upload local images to the WeChat CDN and render math and Mermaid as images
Publish image-message (tie tu) notes with up to 20 pictures
Manage multiple WeChat accounts with default covers and IP-whitelist helper
disambiguation: Not an AI writer, AI illustration tool, or auto-publisher; it only handles formatting and transfer, and final publishing is done manually in the WeChat backend.
extras: Free for personal use, MIT-licensed, desktop-only (does not load on mobile), with full tutorials hosted externally. Includes an optional downloadable 'wechat-draft' Agent Skill requiring Node.js 22, and an optional donation link that unlocks nothing.
problem: Markdown styles break when pasted into WeChat's editor, and code blocks, headings, math and images need manual reformatting before publishing.
